title: gx project
description: A project's project.json in the ticket store. name and repo identify the project; the other keys override config.json for this project only.

name.description: Project name, used in ticket addresses (<project>:<epic>/<id>).

repo.description: Absolute path of the project's repo (or workspace, for a vcs: none project).

vcs.description: "none" for a project without a git repo. Absent means git.

trunk.description: Trunk branch of the project's repo.

landing.description: When a blocker releases its dependents. on-landed: once it has landed on trunk. on-done: once it is done, before it lands; dependents base on the blocker's branch. Default: on-landed.

auto-ff-merge.description: Let the server fast-forward a finished epic onto its target. Default: false.

max-agents.description: Maximum live agents for this project. Absent means no per-project cap.

notifications.description: Replaces the whole global notifications block for this project.

evolve.description: false opts this project out of evolve. Absent or true follows the global evolve mode.

cleanup-command.description: Replaces the global cleanup command for this project. An empty list turns cleanup off for it; an absent key keeps the global command.
